name: Android Authority

sources.title: Android Authority Contact — news@androidauthority.com (leaks/press releases/news), licensing@, sales@, contact@; ad/sponsorship via Authority Media

requirements: Not a directory — earned editorial only; no submission form or listing product
Leaks, press releases, and news go to news@androidauthority.com
General enquiries: contact@androidauthority.com; licensing: licensing@androidauthority.com; ads/sponsorship: sales@androidauthority.com
Android-ecosystem focus: apps, Android devices, mobile tech — a SaaS product needs an Android/mobile app angle
preparation: A mobile/Android angle — an Android app launch, mobile software news, or a device story
Press release or concise news pitch for news@androidauthority.com
App listing assets (Play Store link, screenshots) if pitching an app
workflow: Send the press release or tip to news@androidauthority.com
For review coverage, pitch the app/device to the editorial team via the same inbox or the site's interactive contact form
Coverage, if it happens, is a staff-written news article or review — no listing page is created
For guaranteed placement, the paid route is advertising via sales@androidauthority.com / authoritymedia.com/services
watchFor: Consumer mobile focus — pure B2B SaaS pitches will likely be ignored
Separate paid and earned channels: sales@ is advertising; editorial coverage is not pay-to-play
No guest-post/contributed-article program is advertised on the contact page
countsAsLive: An Android Authority article or review mentioning the product is published at androidauthority.com
unknowns: Review-sample logistics and embargoes process — not documented on the contact page
Whether contributed op-eds are ever accepted — no program found
